text:
maya: Heads up — ran into a flakey onboarding experience in the Next + agent sample. the snippet in `examples/agent-starter` gets stuck sending the same request over and over after a 401, looks like auth refresh + retry loop.

sam: ugh. repro steps?

maya: quick repro: 1) clone sample, 2) set REDWOOD_API_KEY to a short-lived token (we do this in the sandbox), 3) run `npm run dev`, 4) trigger the agent; after ~2s it starts spamming requests and we see 401s continually.

eli: can you paste the minimal snippet?

maya: yep — the agent client does `await client.request(...)` inside a retry wrapper, and the token refresh is async too. here's the simplified flow:

```\n// agent-client.js\nconst token = await getToken(); // may refresh\nfor await (const chunk of client.stream(..., { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` }})) {\n  // process\n}\n```\n
The SDK retry middleware will catch a 401 and call `getToken()` again, but the old streaming call doesn't get cancelled cleanly, so we end up with concurrent attempts and repeated 401s.

francesca: that matches something I saw in an eval harness where telemetry keys rotated mid-run. Looks like there are two issues: 1) streaming calls need cancellation on auth error, and 2) the retry/backoff policy should be idempotency-aware for agent-style streams.

sam: does the browser sample repro or only server?

maya: both — we saw it in next dev server (SSR-like) and a node script. Browser repro has same symptom when token rotation occurs during a streaming session.

eli: quick mitigation: add an early check in the retry handler to abort any active stream before spawning a new attempt. something like: `if (isStream) stream.cancel();` also add a short jittered backoff on 401 refresh so we don't thundering-herd refresh tokens.

francesca: +1. also we should emit a telemetry event when a stream is cancelled due to auth so customers know it's not a content failure. the eval team kept seeing false regressions because streams silently restarted.

maya: logging snippet we saw in prod sandbox: \n```\n[2026-03-22T18:12:03Z] ERROR agent-stream: request failed 401 (token expired)\n[2026-03-22T18:12:03Z] INFO auth: refreshing token\n[2026-03-22T18:12:03Z] ERROR agent-stream: request failed 401 (still)\n[2026-03-22T18:12:03Z] INFO retry: spawning retry attempt #2\n[2026-03-22T18:12:04Z] ERROR agent-stream: concurrent stream started; duplicate output\n```\n
sam: sounds like a small change in the JS SDK. I can whip a draft PR to: 1) add isStream detection, 2) cancel previous streams on 401, 3) ensure retry uses exponential+jitter and honors idempotency header `x-rw-idempotency-key` if present.

eli: add unit tests simulating token rotation mid-stream. we can fake a token provider that flips the token after N bytes and assert we only see one retry attempt.

francesca: for the sample app docs, add a short note in README about ephemeral tokens and how to configure longer TTLs for onboarding to avoid the scatter of 401s. also show the recommended `AuthProvider` hook for Next.

maya: thanks — also discovered one more: the sample's `dev` environment sets `REDWOOD_API_KEY` in `.env.local` but our starter script copies it into an in-memory file watcher that sometimes loses the updated secret on file change. tiny but confusing for new users. we should update the template to rely on `next.config.js` public env flag for local dev, and surface an explicit `npm run start:sandbox` command that seeds a stable token.

dev-bot: Deployed preview build for PR #8123 — link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/8123

sam: I'll open the PR tonight, mark it WIP, and tag @eng-runtime @devex for review. maya — can you add a minimal failing test to the sample folder and attach the logs?

maya: on it, will push test + logs to the PR in ~2 hours. thanks all :rocket:

eli: nice triage. once PR lands, let's put a short blurb in the onboarding checklist so Solutions Engineering doesn't hit this again.

francesca: and I'll add a small eval check that flags unusually high stream retry counts during nightly runs.

maya: done for now — will update thread when PR is up. :white_check_mark:
